perks.name: Lucent Transmutation
perks.description: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Powered Melee Kills or a finisher:
Generates a Light-Subclass Super-Matching Elemental Pickup.
Does nothing while a Stasis or Strand Super is equipped. Kills must be spaced out by at least ~0.2 seconds.

perks.name: Lucent Tithes
perks.description: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 50? HP and spawns 3 Loyal Void Moths that each grant 22.5HP Void Overshield to the user and their allies on impact.

item.name: Elemental Charge
item.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle has an escalating chance to give you Armor Charge.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.
item.exact:
Picking up Elemental Pickups, or destroying Tangles progresses a counter.

Grants x1 Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Counter Progress.

Elemental Pickup Counter Progress:
Void Breaches, Firesprites, and Tangles: 50% | 50% | 100%
Ionic Traces: 34% | 50% | 50% | Shards: 25% | 34% | 50%

item.name: Stacks on Stacks
item.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants you 1 additional stack of Armor Charge.
item.exact: All sources of Armor Charge now grant an additional stack unless explicitly stated not to.
